about_author.title: About the Author
paragraphs: Christopher Tavolazzi is a developer, musician and futurist. He makes videos as The Coffee Jesus and is the founder of Johnny Autoseed, a project to put AI and robotics to work growing food for kitchens and community gardens.
He dictated most of this novel into his phone over several years, walking around and talking out the characters, and rewrote it thirteen times.

back_cover.label: A Solarpunk Novel
headline: So the robots have taken over.
Congratulations!
You’ve lost.
blocks: The night Elijah Madrone ended three careers, he was using artificial intelligence to teach himself how to code.
He showed some realtors what PorusAI could do. A few weeks later, they fired their social media team. Soon after, layoffs came for Elijah’s friends, and then for him.
Now he’s 800 miles north on a solarpunk farm, trying to predict the future while falling in love.
This isn’t a story about fending off hordes of murder bots or uploading your consciousness. This is a story about humanity, arguing with your neighbors, and, you know, just trying to get by.
What if the tools of our time want to save us?
What if AGI arrives and it’s… chill?
Right now, everything is getting a lot weirder, a lot faster.
How are you getting ready to survive?
